name: DongFeng Automobile Co. Ltd.
summary: DongFeng Automobile Co. LTD, established in 1993 and based in Wuhan, People's Republic of China, is actively engaged in the country's automotive sector. The company's extensive operations cover the full spectrum from the conceptualization and engineering to the manufacturing and distribution of vehicles and their constituent components. Its product range includes various types of automobiles, engines, and metal castings, as well as general vehicle parts. Specifically, DongFeng Automobile produces and markets light-duty commercial vehicles, passenger cars, vehicle chasses, engines, and spare parts. Beyond its core manufacturing activities, the company also offers supplementary services such as mechanical processing, vehicle maintenance, and expert technical consultation. It operates as a subsidiary of Dongfeng Motor Co., Ltd.
